subject: Cognitive Science
title: Stereotypes as Categories
description: A fast breakdown of Stereotypes as Categories for builders.

hook.text: You assume the tall man plays basketball. That snap judgment used a social category—a stereotype.

buildup.text: Stereotypes are prototypes applied to people: expected traits mapped onto group membership.

discovery.text: They activate automatically. In milliseconds, category cues trigger trait associations.

twist.text: Even people who reject a stereotype show its activation in implicit association tests.

climax.text: The same mechanism that helps you quickly spot a chair also makes you prejudge a stranger.

quiz.question: How do stereotypes relate to categorization?
options: They apply prototype-like expectations to social groups
